_comment: Hand-maintained catalog entries for everything that is not a job-graph.json lifecycle node: operator scripts, human tasks, standalone Dagster jobs and their ops. consumes/produces name artifacts from artifacts.json, or job:<id> for an accepted lifecycle-job output. Keep in step with the BPMN model and flow-bringup.md; job_catalog.py --check fails when a reference is unknown. preceded_by (step:<id> or job:<id>; null for the first job) maps a step into the engagement flow: --check then fails when it consumes an artifact that a catalog entry produces but no entry before it in the preceded_by chain does. sub_jobs lists the steps a job is made of; each sub-job consumes from the jobs before its parent or from its siblings, and every output of the parent must come from a sub-job. Each mapped step gets a generated BPMN card (docs/processes/bpmn/cards/).

steps.name: Check out the system under test
steps.notes: Clones or fetches, verifies origin, refuses local changes (never resets), checks out the pinned commit and verifies HEAD.

steps.name: Check the Docker engine
steps.notes: Docker Desktop must be the only engine: a native docker.service in the distro competes for /var/run/docker.sock (500 on /version, hangs). docker info reports OperatingSystem "Docker Desktop"; systemctl is-active docker reports inactive.

steps.name: Recover Docker Desktop
steps.notes: Only when docker-check fails. If a native docker service is active in the distro, disable it first (sudo systemctl disable --now docker.service docker.socket containerd.service): it was the root cause of the repeated wedges (2026-09-23).

steps.name: Prepare compose settings and host storage
steps.notes: Writes the .env password and operator uid/gid; creates .host/ as the operator.

steps.name: Start Dagster services
steps.runs: docker compose -f orchestrator/dagster/compose.yaml up -d; compose ps
steps.notes: Waits for webserver, daemon and postgres to report healthy.

steps.name: Start the host code location
steps.notes: Builds the Python 3.12 venv, checks git and libfuzzy, regenerates B16 records only from current successful image fingerprints and immutable Docker image ids, then runs dagster code-server start; image drift fails closed, and if the WSL IP changed it updates .env and recreates webserver and daemon.

steps.name: Check the code location
steps.notes: gRPC health check from the host.

steps.name: Reload job definitions
steps.notes: GraphQL reloadRepositoryLocation, retried for 60 s; required after every start and after pulling job code.

steps.name: nop (plumbing proof)
steps.notes: No run data, target or Docker; proves submit, queue and host execution.

steps.name: Define the engagement
steps.notes: Business goal, platforms, budget, scope and permissions.

steps.name: Grant permissions beyond read-source
steps.notes: Only when the engagement needs more than read-source.

steps.name: Create the run
steps.notes: New run ID and run-owned folders; runs on the host (ADR-0011).

steps.name: Stage the inputs
steps.notes: Records executor platform posix and fingerprints inputs; refuses legacy runs, other platforms and unimported evidence.

steps.name: phase1_intake (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Ops intake_config, intake_pre_validation, intake_work, intake_post_validation; in-process executor, no retries.

steps.name: Correct inputs after an intake failure
steps.notes: Inspect, correct, restage.

steps.name: discovery_gate.set_dispatch_mode: automatic or supplied
steps.notes: Opt-in only, per run and per job; unset defaults to supplied. Not called by any Full-protocol file -- a human or the fast-lane SAT sets this before launching the job so dagster_workflow.py never has to know. All four discovery gates support it: D01 live-confirmed 2026-09-24, D02-D04 2026-09-25.

steps.name: repository_partition_discovery (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Supplied-result gate by default; in automatic mode (dispatch-mode.json), dispatches a real claude CLI persona call, schema-validates the response, and overwrites source_revision/content_hash with orchestrator-pinned values before publish -- never invents the analysis either way.

steps.name: Write the partition map
steps.notes: Partitions, kind of code, persona routing, relationships, scope; SHA-256 citations.

steps.name: Install the supplied partition map
steps.notes: Refuses a target not at the record's commit or with local changes; never overwrites a different supplied file.

steps.name: dev_project_discovery (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Same gate pattern; also requires the accepted partition map at the same source revision.

steps.name: Write the project discovery
steps.notes: Project root, manifests, build image, safe command plan.

steps.name: Install the supplied project discovery
steps.notes: Same checks as supply-partition.

steps.name: devops_project_discovery (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Same gate pattern; requires the accepted partition map at the same source revision. Automatic mode (D03, live 2026-09-25): persona d03-devops, task-devops-project-discovery.md.

steps.name: Write the devops discovery
steps.notes: Container, CI/CD, IaC, packaging and deploy units; safe command plan (no native build tool, no deploy/publish step).

steps.name: Install the supplied devops discovery
steps.notes: Same checks as supply-partition.

steps.name: sre_operations_topology (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Same gate pattern; requires the accepted devops record at the same source revision. Automatic mode (D04, live 2026-09-25): persona d04-sretopology, task-sre-operations-topology.md; the devops record and the partition map are staged together as scope, never evidence.

steps.name: Write the operations topology
steps.notes: Declared services, image, ports, dependencies; controls as configured/tested, never observed; live follow-ups in operational_notes.

steps.name: Install the supplied operations topology
steps.notes: Same checks as supply-partition.

steps.name: Submit a job to Dagster
steps.notes: Allow-listed jobs only; refuses non-POSIX runs; records SUBMITTING before launchRun; finds an existing run by request and engagement tags instead of launching twice.

steps.name: Dagster accepts or rejects the launch
steps.notes: Queue limits: 2 runs overall, 1 per engagement. Validation errors come back as REJECTED.

steps.name: engagement_workflow (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Preparation workflow: config, intake, three preparation branches, validated join. Not a full lifecycle review.

steps.name: workflow_config (op)
steps.notes: Checks the engagement_run_id tag, takes generation ownership, records the attempt config.

steps.name: workflow_intake (op)
steps.notes: Atomic intake: configure, prepare, work (or reuse), publish.

steps.name: scope_check (op)
steps.notes: Preparation branch.

steps.name: native_plan_check (op)
steps.notes: Preparation branch.

steps.name: discovery_handoffs (op)
steps.notes: Preparation branch.

steps.name: workflow_publish (op)
steps.notes: Rechecks freshness, validates every branch, publishes the join.

steps.name: build_index (Dagster job)
steps.notes: build_index.py (built 2026-09-25): deterministic indexer on the common envelope. Enumerates candidate units (one per build root: dir:<root>, or file:<Dockerfile|compose>), places nested and vendored roots as members or not-units with a cited reason, and collects cited build signals (build systems, toolchain and dependency declarations, CI and Dockerfile recipes, README build text, JS/TS markers) under 400 signals / 4 KiB excerpts / 512 KiB, every omission counted. Assigns no class. Executes nothing. docs/processes/build-resolution.md, ADR-0012 revision 1.

steps.name: build_classify (Dagster job)
steps.notes: build_classify.py (built 2026-09-25, ADR-0012 revision 2): one claude-sonnet-5/medium persona call reads the whole checkout and the accepted build index, gives every index unit one cited class (mixed units split into parts), and records where the index is wrong (index_review, never applied). The orchestrator sets source_revision, index, build_set and citation hashes; every unit covered exactly once, signal ids and citations checked before publication.

steps.name: build_plan (Dagster job)
steps.notes: build_plan.py (built and live-confirmed 2026-09-26, SAT 20260926T215329Z, ADR-0012 revisions 2-3): one Haiku persona call per build-set unit reads the whole checkout, the accepted index and classification, the buildenv catalog and an orchestrator-written plan-unit.json, and plans that unit: base image, apt packages, ordered configure/build argv, compile-database method, feasibility tier, all cited. The compiler is fixed (our clang): no compiler, CC=/CXX= or compiler package; no test, check or install step; argv only, offline, inside the tree. The orchestrator sets toolchain, dispositions, upstream refs and citation hashes. An empty build set makes no model call. Fault-recovery qualification remains.

steps.name: build_resolution (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Implemented and live-qualified 2026-09-27. Per build-set unit: render a closed Dockerfile, provision only from the granted apt mirror, trial accepted configure/build argv through offline B13 with a read-only target and sole writable /scratch, require a non-empty clang-only compile database, then publish an immutable image_build_<id> catalog entry and build lock. Caller-held B13 hashes, newest-failure blocking and explicit recovery are qualified. Nothing built is run.

steps.name: build_configure (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Implemented and happy-path qualified in SAT 20260927T005731Z. Replays only the accepted lock's configure argv from a fresh scratch copy through offline B13, with the target read-only and caller-held result hashes. Fault/recovery qualification remains.

steps.name: native_build (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Implemented and happy-path qualified in SAT 20260927T005731Z. Replays the accepted configure and build argv through offline B13 and publishes the clang compile database plus produced native binaries. Fault/recovery qualification remains.

steps.name: source_sast (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Implemented with pinned offline C/C++, Go, Java and PHP adapters through the existing run seam. Outputs remain normalized evidence leads, never findings or severity; unavailable language tools remain explicit coverage gaps. C/C++ happy path was live-qualified in SAT 20260927T005731Z; Go/Java/PHP live and fault/recovery qualification remain.

steps.name: native_memory_analysis (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Standalone config-driven bounded transform. Re-verifies explicitly named accepted native inputs and publishes candidate-only memory analysis with open proof obligations. Full-review input assembly and live qualification remain gaps.

steps.name: fuzz_target_triage (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Standalone config-driven deterministic harness-feasibility ranking. No fuzz campaign, crash observation or finding is claimed. Full-review input assembly and live qualification remain gaps.

steps.name: owasp_validation_worklist (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Standalone OWASP-only worklist transform. Applicability and evidence requirements remain NOT_ASSESSED; it is distinct from STIG/SRG validation and deployment hardening. Full-review input assembly and live qualification remain gaps.

steps.name: stig_srg_validation_worklist (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Standalone DISA STIG/SRG-only worklist transform. Platform tailoring remains NOT_ASSESSED; it is distinct from OWASP validation and deployment hardening. Full-review input assembly and live qualification remain gaps.

steps.name: deployment_hardening (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Standalone static deployment-hardening transform. Runtime state and compliance remain explicit gaps; this assessment is distinct from both standards worklist jobs. Full-review input assembly and live qualification remain gaps.

steps.name: L6B threat-model reconciliation (active implementation)
steps.runs: pending executable support for lifecycle job 03-threat-model-reconciliation
steps.notes: Planned separate L6B process. It will reconcile the accepted L6A DFD/STRIDE model with accepted evidence, preserve conflicts and coverage gaps, and publish threat-model-reconciliation.json. Execution support and qualification are pending; L6A must not be presented as a reconciled final model.

steps.name: sbom_inventory (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Standalone config-driven Syft/B13 inventory with network none and an exact source-generation binding. Full-review input assembly and live Docker qualification remain gaps.

steps.name: sca_vulnerability_match (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Standalone config-driven Grype+OSV matching. The supplied offline snapshot registry is re-hashed and age-checked; absent or stale snapshots fail closed. Snapshot synchronization is outside the analysis DAG and matches remain evidence leads.

steps.name: license_scan (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Standalone config-driven ScanCode/B13 license inventory bound to the accepted SBOM. Full-review input assembly and live Docker qualification remain gaps.

steps.name: dependency_lifecycle (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Standalone deterministic offline transform with explicit reference-table hash and age ceiling; missing coverage is unknown, never supported. Full-review input assembly remains a gap.

steps.name: cve_reachability (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Standalone deterministic static reachability transform over run-supplied evidence. A version match alone never establishes reachability and all outputs remain evidence leads. In full_review, 06-cve-reachability is instead the ADR-0023 correlator (lifecycle op) over 06-reachability-codeql and 06-reachability-ir; see docs/dependency-reachability.md.

steps.name: b13_harmless_container (Dagster qualification job)
steps.notes: Standalone Phase 3 integration proof: fixture-harmless only, B13 pinned image and argv, zero-capability permission decision, no mounts or network, Docker pool, common lifecycle/envelope/publication. Bounded live qualification proves immutable reuse, controlled non-zero failure, no fallback, recovery and recovered-attempt reuse. No scanner, finding, severity or lifecycle readiness claim.

steps.name: build_discovery (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Cited build requirements and command arrays; nothing is executed.

steps.name: build_execution (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Standalone diagnostic: one CMake root only, via the buildenv-common wrapper, not B13. Superseded for S6 by batch E01.

steps.name: evidence_index (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Independent source branch; the index is a locator, never evidence authority.

steps.name: critical_findings_sarif (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Fixed-input transform to accepted SARIF; the final lifecycle publication binding is missing.

steps.name: ossf_scorecard (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Published-results ingestion (network pool).

steps.name: nvd_reference_sync (Dagster job)
steps.runs: schedule nvd_reference_schedule (every 2 h, UTC) or manual launch
steps.notes: Shared reference feed outside every engagement run; APPSEC_NVD_SCHEDULE=stopped disables the schedule.

steps.name: orchestration_smoke (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Pre-validation, work, post-validation smoke path.

steps.name: full_review (Dagster job)
steps.notes: The whole current lifecycle graph; stops at the first node with no worker or accepted prerequisite. Its per-node inputs and outputs are in Appendix B.

steps.name: Legacy evidence pipeline
steps.notes: Static prepass, native pregather, assemble, correlate, deep_confirm, retrieval plan; imported into a run by hashed import. Being replaced by the 02-* graph nodes.

steps.name: Dispatch LLM lanes
steps.notes: Hand-off files for the tracked prompt harness; lanes are not yet graph workers.
